options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Logic
options.doc: Choose the logic used by the randomizer.

options.name: Skip Intro
options.doc:
Skips escaping the police station.

Graffiti spots tagged during the intro will not unlock items.

options.name: Skip Dreams
options.doc:
Skips the dream sequences at the end of each chapter.

This can be changed later in the options menu inside the Archipelago phone app.

options.name: Skip Statue Hands
options.doc: Skips spraying the lion statue hands after the dream in Chapter 5.

options.name: Total REP
options.doc:
Change the total amount of REP in your world.

At least 960 REP is needed to finish the game.

Will be rounded to the nearest number divisible by 8.

options.name: Extra REP Required
options.doc: Changes the final boss to require 1000 REP instead of 960 REP to start.

options.name: Starting Movestyle
options.doc: Choose which movestyle to start with.

options.name: Limited Graffiti
options.doc:
Each graffiti design can only be used a limited number of times before being removed from your inventory.

In some cases, such as completing a dream, using graffiti to defeat enemies, or spraying over your own graffiti, uses will not be counted.

If enabled, doing graffiti is disabled during crew battles, to prevent softlocking.

options.name: Small Graffiti Uses
options.doc:
Choose if small graffiti should be separate, meaning that you will need to switch characters every time you run out, or combined, meaning that unlocking new characters will add 5 uses that any character can use.

Has no effect if Limited Graffiti is disabled.

options.name: Skip Polo Photos
options.doc: Skip taking pictures of Polo for items.

options.name: Don't Save Photos
options.doc:
Photos taken with the Camera app will not be saved.

This can be changed later in the options menu inside the Archipelago phone app.

options.name: Score Difficulty
options.doc:
Alters the score required to win score challenges and crew battles.

This can be changed later in the options menu inside the Archipelago phone app.

options.name: Damage Multiplier
options.doc:
Multiplies all damage received.

At 3x, most damage will OHKO the player, including falling into pits.
At 6x, all damage will OHKO the player.

This can be changed later in the options menu inside the Archipelago phone app.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc:
When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

This can be changed later in the options menu inside the Archipelago phone app.
options.doc_html:

options.doc: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}

options.name: Start Hints
options.doc: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
options.doc_html: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the !hint command.

options.name: Start Location Hints
options.doc: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
options.doc_html: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the !hint command.

options.name: Excluded Locations
options.doc: Prevent these locations from having an important item.

options.name: Priority Locations
options.doc: Prevent these locations from having an unimportant item.
